standing: production bundle candidate; not a published release

packages.name: analysis-binding
packages.description: Bind each computation a data application needs to a domain method and a versioned implementation with a typed interface, grounded parameter values, preconditions, explicit result semantics and known-answer tests, or specify the missing component as new work, with independent examination of numerical meaning.

packages.name: audit-decomp
packages.description: Reconcile accepted decomposition with materialized scope and current derivative evidence.

packages.name: audit-dep-closure
packages.description: Inspect consumer-local deliverable.yaml needs and derive bounded dependency findings without changing declarations or evaluating readiness.

packages.name: audit-epistemic
packages.description: Inspect what claims assert, what warrants them, and what uncertainty or conflict affects reliance.

packages.name: audit-governance
packages.description: Compare governance rules, references, terminology, and authority claims with their evidence.

packages.name: audit-hypergraph-closure
packages.description: Assess whether a graph snapshot’s structure and coverage match its declared source basis.

packages.name: audit-scope-closure
packages.description: Follow an accepted amendment through implementation, reruns, and remaining closure obligations.

packages.name: bounded-reconciliation
packages.description: Compare affected deliverable commitments, design and dependency conditions with a concrete result and make warranted source edits.

packages.name: compare-library-derivations
packages.description: Compare selected Library-derived project files with their actual sources and discuss which differences to retain, change or propose upstream.

packages.name: construct-local-work-graph
packages.description: Derive the relevant dependency neighbourhood and plan a route from the user's intended result to usable work.

packages.name: content-digest
packages.description: Read one deliverable folder and produce a structured 7-section content digest summarizing identity, scope, document kit, dependencies, references, semantic framework, and quality observations.

packages.name: coordinated-knowledge-work
packages.description: Use when related contributions must become one usable knowledge-work result and the team needs sustained ownership, independent assurance, shared changes, and completion.

packages.name: create-workflow
packages.description: Create or revise a reusable Chirality workflow through conversation, package it in the intended library, and verify discovery and readiness for reuse.

packages.name: data-app-build
packages.description: Build an interactive data application with an agent from an accepted specification closure only, decide conformance with a test suite generated from the specification before the build, examine the result independently, and present the built application for the owner's acceptance without deploying it.

packages.name: data-app-spec
packages.description: Develop a declarative specification for an interactive data application with the human, from new intent through a design record or from an existing app; bind its domain knowledge and analyses, validate and examine it, obtain acceptance of the identified specification closure, and hand it to an agent build or to software-decomp as its accepted basis.

packages.name: dbm-concordance-seed
packages.description: Transform raw concordance evidence atoms and risk inventory rows into typed publication concordance candidates for register freeze review.

packages.name: dbm-concordance-verify
packages.description: Review semantic consistency across an authored DBM's sections, using current text and available review evidence; supports publication packages and standalone drafts.

packages.name: dbm-draft-review
packages.description: Review a human-prepared draft DBM against the governed knowledge base — build review substrate, prepare candidate findings for human disposition.

packages.name: dbm-postauthor-concordance
packages.description: Post-authoring evidence bundle and review for pipeline-produced DBM sections — build review substrate, prepare candidate findings for human readiness judgment.

packages.name: dbm-publish
packages.description: Assemble the full rewritten DBM package from approved section outputs and produce package QA artifacts.

packages.name: dbm-publisher
packages.description: Develop and publish one engineering Design Basis Memorandum from accepted domain state, with frozen planning, section production, post-authoring review, and human acceptance.

packages.name: dbm-section-publish
packages.description: Publish exactly one rewritten DBM section from approved mapped DOMAIN inputs and emit fixed QA artifacts.

packages.name: decomposition-package-review
packages.description: Review one DOMAIN decomposition package as a closed system for derivative parity, active snapshot completeness, and handoff-state readiness. Use when a root-level remediation or scope-change run needs package-level closure evidence before downstream work or phase advancement.

packages.name: define-work
packages.description: Clarify or revise the work needed for an intended contribution so it can be assigned, carried out, coordinated or examined, using the smallest useful definition.

packages.name: dependency-extract
packages.description: Author or refresh a deliverable's consumer-local needs in deliverable.yaml from its scope, sources and intended use.

packages.name: domain-decomp
packages.description: Develop a coherent domain ontology while preserving source meaning, identity, and disagreement.

packages.name: domain-documents
packages.description: Draft knowledge-artifact document set for a DOMAIN Knowledge Type deliverable. Produces KA-* files per the variable artifact schema. DOMAIN pipeline only.

packages.name: domain-engine
packages.description: Integrate a deterministic domain engine with explicit computational coverage and human judgment.

packages.name: domain-hypergraph
packages.description: Discover source-backed domain entities and build a traceable graph projection.

packages.name: domain-knowledge-intake
packages.description: Turn domain sources and expert input into an identified, warranted domain knowledge pack (criteria, methods and their applicability, parameter tables, assumptions, definitions and caveats), reconciled, examined by a competent domain reviewer and accepted for a stated scope of use by data-application specifications.

packages.name: domain-prose-validate
packages.description: Independently re-extract one rasterized PDF page's prose, equations, and asset placeholders for downstream extraction-reproducibility comparison (Gate 1.5-P Stage 1).

packages.name: domain-source-atomize
packages.description: Per-dispatch-unit bounded atomization of one slice of one DOMAIN source markdown into IN/OUT/TBD atomic units with dual SourceRefs, content hashes, and vocabulary seeds. Invoked by the WORKING_ITEMS (workflow: domain-decomp) orchestrator for per-skeleton-dispatch-unit fanout in Phase 2.

packages.name: drawing-extract
packages.description: Extract target-specific evidence from engineering drawings through coverage design, bounded visual extraction, deterministic QA, assembly, and recovery.

packages.name: drawing-extract-page
packages.description: Per-page bounded extraction of structured data from a single engineering drawing page image, using crop-first multiblock VLM reasoning. Drawing-type-aware (PFD implemented; P_AND_ID, ISOMETRIC, GA stubbed). Invoked by the drawing-extract orchestrator for per-page fanout.

packages.name: drawing-titleblock-page
packages.description: Per-page titleblock extraction from drawing sheets using four corner crops and a full-page thumbnail; emits a governed sheet-inventory stub.

packages.name: equation-audit
packages.description: Review extracted display equations with the human, interpret correction notes, apply validated fixes, backcheck changes, and close an immutable audit snapshot.

packages.name: equation-bbox-detect
packages.description: Detect display-equation bounding boxes on one rasterized page PNG using multimodal vision and emit normalized coordinates for downstream cropping. Per-page bounded dispatch invoked by equation-audit during Phase 1 when per-equation crops are enabled.

packages.name: equation-flag-interpret
packages.description: Convert one human-written natural-language correction note about one display equation into a corrected LaTeX expression. Per-flag bounded dispatch invoked by equation-audit during Phase 3a, one TASK per flagged entry whose `description` is prose rather than LaTeX.

packages.name: equipment-costing-extract
packages.description: Extract costing-relevant design basis parameters for equipment matching a target module type list from KA files in a single KTY folder. Use when building equipment costing registers for cost estimation.

packages.name: equipment-extract
packages.description: Extract discrete physical equipment items from Knowledge Artifact files within a single DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder. Use when building per-KTY equipment registers from KA production documents.

packages.name: estimate-prep
packages.description: Generates estimation input package (pricing library, LOE, project parameters, BOE) via two-phase run with PHASE=SCAFFOLD|BOE modes and a human gate between invocations.

packages.name: estimate-snapshot
packages.description: Generate an immutable, provenance-first estimate snapshot for a bounded scope of deliverables and/or packages, writing quarantined artifacts under the estimating tool root. Use for automated estimate runs driven by a validated BASIS_OF_ESTIMATE enum and local pricing sources.

packages.name: evaluation-protocol
packages.description: Coordinate evidence-grounded evaluation, bounded audits, optional scoring, and remediation handoffs.

packages.name: evaluation-report
packages.description: Evaluate one dimension against an accepted rubric and return a supported score.

packages.name: integrated-engineering-estimate-schedule
packages.description: Construct or revise one coupled engineering effort/cost and resource-loaded schedule case from accepted work inputs, with distinct reconciled projections and consumer outputs.

packages.name: kty-content-remediate
packages.description: Archive, tombstone, verify, and emit disposition evidence for DOMAIN KTY content after an approved scope change without rewriting active Knowledge Artifact content.

packages.name: kty-metadata-align
packages.description: Review and optionally align one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder's metadata surfaces to approved decomposition truth without rewriting Scoping.md or KA content. Use after regeneration or scope change when `_CONTEXT.md`, `_STATUS.md`, or `_REFERENCES.md` may have drifted.

packages.name: lens-register
packages.description: Generate a matrix-organized, coverage-complete semantic lensing register (_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md) from _SEMANTIC.md + production documents. Setup-pipeline companion to the interactive semantic-lensing workflow.

packages.name: pdf2md
packages.description: Convert a bounded PDF to Markdown in one TASK assignment, using vision and deterministic cleanup and assembly tools.

packages.name: pdf2md-folio-extract
packages.description: Read one rasterized PDF page and emit the visible printed folio label (page number as it appears on the page itself — "47", "xiv", "B-3", or null when no folio is printed).

packages.name: pdf2md-orchestration
packages.description: Coordinate recoverable PDF conversion through page-bounded vision, deterministic cleanup and asset materialization, assembly, and explicit degraded-output review.

packages.name: pdf2md-page
packages.description: LEGACY Markdown-only page transcription for explicitly selected historical PDF resume contracts; new conversion runs use pdf2md-page-full.

packages.name: pdf2md-page-assets
packages.description: LEGACY separate asset discovery from a PDF page image and Markdown sidecar, retained for historical resume contracts; new conversion runs use pdf2md-page-full.

packages.name: pdf2md-page-full
packages.description: Single-page merged VLM pass that produces BOTH the raw Markdown transcription and the bbox-normalized asset JSON from one vision read of the page image. Replaces the prior two-workflow split (pdf2md-page + pdf2md-page-assets) for new dispatches.

packages.name: project-decomp
packages.description: Turn a project scope into cohesive Packages and bounded Deliverables with explicit objectives and boundaries.

packages.name: project-setup
packages.description: Materialize accepted project scope as current deliverable localities, author local contracts and needs, and reconcile affected work before integration. Retained domain and legacy setup is the separate project-setup-retained workflow.

packages.name: project-setup-retained
packages.description: Set up or incrementally update a project that explicitly retains the DOMAIN route or the legacy phase and control-file route. Current PROJECT/SOFTWARE setup uses project-setup.

packages.name: reconciliation
packages.description: Reconcile claims, artifacts, implementation, evidence, lifecycle, and unfulfilled obligations (legacy Remaining only where pinned) with accepted project truth.

packages.name: reflect-on-work
packages.description: Examine with the human whether a concrete finding calls purpose, commitments, explanatory framing or chosen practice into question, and carry a warranted retain or change decision into the owning work.

packages.name: research-orchestration
packages.description: Coordinate bounded research streams, independent verification, recoverable evidence, and synthesis.

packages.name: reverse-engineer-software
packages.description: Examine an existing software project, recover useful exemplars and lessons from its implementation and records, and develop a successor PRD and supporting documents with the human. Also supports a bounded reference account when that is the requested outcome.

packages.name: review
packages.description: Guide evidence review and human disposition for a deliverable lifecycle transition.

packages.name: scope-change
packages.description: Amend accepted decomposition and propagate the consequences through their owning workflows.

packages.name: scope-change-packet
packages.description: Produce a bounded PKG-00 Scope Change Consumable Packet for later human-initiated WORKING_ITEMS (workflow: scope-change) intake.

packages.name: scope-of-work
packages.description: Initialize, convert, revise under an accepted scope-change amendment, validate, and independently verify one objective-anchored PROJECT/SOFTWARE ScopeOfWork.md under the active SOW_V1 transition contract. Do not use for DOMAIN/KTY or independent schemas, lifecycle changes, or unauthorized corpus conversion.

packages.name: semantic-lensing
packages.description: Apply semantic lensing analysis to deliverable documents using _SEMANTIC.md matrices. Treats lensing entries as a candidate worklist, tags proposals with matrix coordinates, and optionally updates lens artifacts.

packages.name: semantic-matrix-build
packages.description: Generate one deliverable-local semantic lens (_SEMANTIC.md) by adopting canonical matrices A and B and deriving C, F, D, K, G, X, T, and E with explicit semantic-algebra working.

packages.name: software-decomp
packages.description: Organize software intent into cohesive work domains and implementable bounded contexts.

packages.name: software-prd
packages.description: Develop a product requirements document for a new software product or a defined development undertaking with the human, examine the complete candidate independently, and hand the human-accepted PRD to software-decomp as its accepted basis. For a successor PRD formed by examining an existing project, use reverse-engineer-software. Not for maintenance, bug repair, issue-ticket execution, or stand-alone data repair or analysis.

packages.name: software-repository-reconnaissance
packages.description: Map a software repository's manifests, architecture, test surfaces, commands, ownership boundaries, and risks before planning or implementation. Use for unfamiliar repositories, novel stacks, package activation, or before sealing a software work brief.

packages.name: software-test-planning
packages.description: Derive a risk-based verification plan and affected registered checks for a bounded software change. Use before implementation, at fan-in, or after a defect when test selection, evidence sufficiency, negative cases, or acceptance gates must be made explicit.
